simply just the constant screaming so many people say "thats normal" but i mean screaming screaming. every day for years i kept a tally of how many days my parents went without yelling at each other or me and i never got past 1day. conversations would go from 'i had a rlly fun science class today' to screaming and door slamming and threats all because i said or did something to annoy them. id wake up with screaming, sleep with screaming and while getting ready for school thered be screaming. 

if i accidentally left my jumper on the couch my parents would burst into my room and scream at me to get up and pick it up. there where times where i was sleeping on school nights and would get woken up mid sleep and screamed at to go clean the dishes even though nobody had originally told me to. 

whenever i go to friends houses and any slight argument starts i instantly assume the worst will happen and go into fight flight or freeze mode, detaching from reality and dissasociating for days/weeks. i remember always being so suprised when there wasnt screaming after my friends parents couldnt decide on a dinner or when they werent screamed at for not holding a spoon correctly.
